div.div:
Baek Jinwoo, savior of humanity, is done with being a hero. In his last moments, this battle-scarred warrior vows never to pick up a sword again. But by some cruel twist of fate, he finds himself reborn as Riley Finn Epheletta, the youngest son of an esteemed family of swordmasters! When trouble comes knocking, Riley is forced to make a decision — take up the sword, or let his loved ones die. Will the “Lazy Sword” finally bloom into the legendary swordmaster he was always destined to become?
(Source: Tapas)

"A tsundere chairwoman, a demure secretary, a black diamond of a South African princess, a unique female bodyguard, and a carrot-eating, somewhat typical, bishounen - how will these people fall in love? Whether it was fate inevitable or the heart's machinations, if you meet with the Godly Expert, you will experience a one-of-a-kind apprentice life." (Source: QQ, translated)
